entities.summary: Ibrahima Thomas is a Senegalese professional basketball player who currently plays for Al-Nasr in Kuwait. He previously also played for the Senegal national basketball team. Thomas played college basketball for Oklahoma State before transferring to Cincinnati as a sophomore.
